items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I played with Willie, I played with Oil, and I never played with Poisey. Willie and Oil played trombone with me.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jim was the grandfather. The grandfather. You played with him as far? I played with Willie, I played with Oil, and I never played with Poisey. Willie and Oil played trombone with me.
Oh, he was with your band?
